blurb: Belmont Park offers a variety of rides and attractions including a historic rollercoaster, zipline, laser tag, mini golf, and arcade games. Guests can celebrate birthdays and other events with customizable party packages including rides, food, and reserved seating. Season passes and wristbands provide unlimited access to rides and attractions with special discounts and bring-a-buddy days.
extraNote: Additional party time may be added for $150 per hour · Universal Tickets are non-refundable but do not expire · Wristbands are good for one day and are non-refundable · Wristbands may be upgraded to annual passes on the same day of purchase at main ticket office · Pets are not permitted; ADA service animals allowed · No outside alcohol, weapons, or disruptive items allowed at concerts · Main ticket office located next to the Giant Dipper rollercoaster
